derivation: from a compound of G5525 (χορός) and G71 (ἄγω);
def: to be a dance-leader, i.e. (generally) to furnish

occurrences.text: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
